assistant across various data science and computer science courses.

<style>
  .teaching-list {
    display: grid;
    gap: 1rem;

  }
  .teaching-map-title {
    margin: 1.7rem 0 .25rem;
    font-size: 1.15rem;
    font-weight: 650;
  }
  .teaching-map-note { color: #6b7280; font-size: .86rem; }
  .teaching-map {
    margin-top: 1rem;
    padding: 1.25rem 0 .8rem;
    overflow-x: auto;
    scrollbar-width: thin;
  }
  .teaching-route {
    position: relative;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(9, minmax(105px, 1fr));
    min-width: 980px;
    padding: 0 .8rem;
  }
  .teaching-route::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    top: 2.55rem;
    right: 1.2rem;
    left: 1.2rem;
    height: 4px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f59e0b, #22a06b 42%, #2c6bed 72%, #7c3aed);
  }
  .teaching-stop {
    position: relative;
    min-width: 0;
    padding: 0 .3rem;
    text-align: center;
  }
  .teaching-term {
    min-height: 1.5rem;
    color: #4b5563;
    font-size: .76rem;
    font-weight: 650;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .teaching-dot {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
    margin: .35rem auto .75rem;
    border: 4px solid #fff;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #2c6bed;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #2c6bed;
  }
  .teaching-stop:first-child .teaching-dot { background: #f59e0b; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #f59e0b; }
  .teaching-stop:last-child .teaching-dot { background: #7c3aed; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #7c3aed; }
  .teaching-map-entry {
    margin: .35rem 0;
    padding: .45rem .35rem;
    border: 1px solid #e6e8eb;
    border-radius: 9px;
    background: #fff;
    box-shadow: 0 1px 5px rgba(0, 0, 0, .05);
    line-height: 1.2;
  }
  .teaching-map-course { display: block; font-size: .76rem; font-weight: 700; color: #2c6bed; }
  .teaching-course-link { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
  .teaching-course-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
  .teaching-map-role { display: block; margin-top: .15rem; color: #6b7280; font-size: .65rem; }
  .teaching-map-entry.intern .teaching-map-course { color: #b45309; }
  .teaching-map-entry.tutor .teaching-map-course { color: #15803d; }
  .teaching-details-title {
    margin: 2rem 0 -.55rem;
    font-size: 1.15rem;
    font-weight: 650;
  }
  .teaching-chain {
    max-width: 940px;
    margin-top: 2.2rem;
  }
  .teaching-chain svg {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    margin-top: .75rem;
    border: 1px solid #e6e8eb;
    border-radius: 14px;
    background: linear-gradient(145deg, #fbfdff, #f7f5ff);
  }
  .chain-edge { fill: none; stroke: #a9b4c6; stroke-width: 2.5; marker-end: url(#chain-arrow); }
  .chain-edge.loop { stroke: #7c8da8; }
  .chain-pulse { fill: #7c3aed; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 4px rgba(124, 58, 237, .65)); }
  .chain-node circle { fill: #fff; stroke: #2c6bed; stroke-width: 3; }
  .chain-node:hover circle { fill: #eef4ff; stroke-width: 4; }
  .chain-node text { fill: #1f2937; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; text-anchor: middle; }
  .chain-count { fill: #6b7280; font-size: 12px; text-anchor: middle; }
  .chain-label { fill: #6b7280; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; paint-order: stroke; stroke: #fff; stroke-width: 4px; }
  .teaching-card {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(8rem, 11rem) 1fr;
    gap: 1rem 1.4rem;
    padding: 1.2rem 1.35rem;
    border: 1px solid #e6e8eb;
    border-radius: 14px;
    background: #fff;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, .05);
  }
  .teaching-code {
    color: #2c6bed;
    font-size: 1.05rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: .01em;
  }
  .teaching-title {
    margin-bottom: .75rem;
    font-size: 1.05rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1.35;
  }
  .teaching-role {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(9rem, auto) 1fr;
    gap: .35rem 1rem;
    padding: .32rem 0;
    border-top: 1px solid #f0f1f3;
    font-size: .92rem;
  }
  .teaching-role:first-of-type { border-top: 0; }
  .teaching-role-name { font-weight: 600; }
  .teaching-terms { color: #6b7280; }
  @media (max-width: 640px) {
    .teaching-card { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: .35rem; }
    .teaching-role { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: .05rem; }
  }
</style>
